name: Summer Camps at Kingston Hill Academy
description_short: Short summer day camps held at Kingston Hill Academy in Saunderstown, RI, listed in the school's July 2026 newsletter: Wizard Camp, a Day Camp, a Garden Art & Sciences Camp (mainly in the outdoor classroom) and an outdoor Bike & STEM Camp, each running one or two weeks in July.
